bifrost: springboard/src/shell/photos/ (built-in Photos app, reads ~/Pictures); springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/picker.rs (camera-roll sheet). App API: springboard/sdk/src/photo_library.rs with the photos service
summary: BifrOSt has a built-in Photos app that browses a folder-based library (All Photos, Favorites, Recently Deleted, Screenshots, Recents), with thumbnails, a viewer, a slideshow, a basic editor and JPEG EXIF reading. Apps get no PhotoKit-style API: there is no shared library access, no asset fetch, no picker, no Live Photo, no editing extension and no change observation.

gaps: App-facing photo library covers fetch, authorization and thumbnails only: no asset creation, collections, isFavorite or change observation.
No system picker for apps: only Notes has a local camera-roll sheet that reads ~/Pictures directly.
No Live Photo support in the library or the viewer (PHLivePhoto).
No video assets in the Photos app (PHAsset video media type).
No photo editing extension point (PHContentEditingController) or project extension point.
No library change observation for apps (PHPhotoLibraryChangeObserver), and no per-asset permission grants.
Metadata is JPEG EXIF only; no extended asset metadata object for apps.
